stage: WebGL 2 fallback, prompt 1: shader feasibility + GLSL ES shader-helper extension
scope: Prove the pinned Slang can produce GLSL ES 3.00 that compiles, links and renders changing mixed-layout uniforms in real WebGL 2. Software GPU only; no hardware or hosted acceptance. No engine WebGL backend yet (prompt 2).

direct_slang_glsl_es.root_cause: Slang's only GLSL target is desktop/Vulkan GLSL (emits #version 450/460); there is no ESSL / #version 300 es target or capability (only glsl_spirv_*).

evidence.vertex_version_with_SV_VertexID: #version 460 + #extension GL_ARB_shader_draw_parameters : require, gl_VertexIndex, gl_BaseVertex (desktop-only; absent in WebGL 2)
evidence.slang_glsl_capabilities: only glsl_spirv_* (Vulkan-flavored GLSL); no ESSL / #version 300 es capability

chosen_path: build-time SPIR-V -> GLSL ES 3.00 translation with pinned SPIRV-Cross

authored_source_change.what: tools/shader-probe/probe.slang and tests/sdk_consumer/shaders/diagnostic.slang vertex input SV_VertexID -> SV_VulkanVertexID
authored_source_change.why: SPIRV-Cross rejects BaseVertex/BaseInstance in the ES profile; Slang maps SV_VertexID to D3D base-relative semantics requiring SPV_KHR_shader_draw_parameters (shader-slang/slang#6992). SV_VulkanVertexID maps to plain VertexIndex / vertex_index / gl_VertexID.
authored_source_change.backend_safety: Identical value for the non-indexed, zero-base-vertex fullscreen draw. SPIR-V entry stays 'main'; reflection, WGSL entries (vertexMain/fragmentMain) and WGSL std140 layout unchanged.
authored_source_change.verified: shader-probe check_reflection and check_wgsl both PASS on the updated probe.slang

spirv_emit: out/shader-tools/slang/bin/slangc tools/shader-probe/probe.slang -target spirv -profile spirv_1_3 -entry vertexMain -stage vertex -o out/shader-probe-webgl/probe.vertex.spv
out/shader-tools/slang/bin/slangc tools/shader-probe/probe.slang -target spirv -profile spirv_1_3 -entry fragmentMain -stage fragment -o out/shader-probe-webgl/probe.fragment.spv

generated_glsl_es.vertex: #version 300 es; void main(){ gl_Position = ...gl_VertexID...; }  (no gl_BaseVertex, no extensions)
generated_glsl_es.fragment_block: layout(std140) uniform ProbeUniforms_std140 { highp vec2 resolution; highp float elapsedTime; highp vec3 direction; highp vec4 tint; } probe;
generated_glsl_es.fragment_output: layout(location = 0) out highp vec4; top-left gl_FragCoord

note_fragment_spv_unchanged: probe.fragment.spv sha256 (38f3a4...) equals the ADR 0010 shader-toolchain evidence; only the vertex module changed with SV_VulkanVertexID.

helper_extension_checks.baseline_no_glsl_es: manifest keys unchanged; no .essl emitted; SPIR-V/WGSL byte-for-byte identical
helper_extension_checks.glsl_es_path: sample.{vertex,fragment}.essl emitted; manifest uniform_sizes.glsl_es=48, glsl_es_entries main/main, profiles.glsl_es='300 es', glsl_es_layout verified, .essl hashed
helper_extension_checks.generated_header: compiles with g++ -std=c++23 -Wall -Wextra -Werror in native and -DLUDUS_PLATFORM_WEB configs; web branch carries WGSL + GLSL ES; native branch unchanged
helper_extension_checks.verify_shader_build_assertions: new GLSL ES block PASS against fixture manifest/artifacts

backend_integration_note: ShaderDescription gains backend-independent GlslEs/GlslEsEntry (string_view) + the browser build carries both WGSL and GLSL ES; no backend objects or private headers are exposed. The engine WebGL 2 backend (prompt 2) compiles result.GlslEs, links through main, binds the std140 block at binding 0 (bindBufferBase), uploads the app-verified layout, and re-checks UNIFORM_BLOCK_DATA_SIZE/UNIFORM_OFFSET against the upload struct before drawing. CreateShader borrows GlslEs only during creation, consistent with the existing Spirv/Wgsl contract. Downstream game integration uses only the installed SDK public APIs; the private probe here is confined to feasibility.
unresolved_gates: Engine WebGL 2 backend, canvas ownership and WebGPU->WebGL2 startup fallback (prompt 2)
Pinned spirv-val/spirv-dis and the full pinned helper require glibc 2.38; verified here with Slang (glibc 2.27) + from-source SPIRV-Cross and spirv-val v2025.1
